item.title: Evolution of urban spatial structure
item.content:encoded:
This call invites submissions on the evolution of urban spatial structure, examining how cities have transformed and developed over time. The special issue seeks research that explores the dynamics, patterns, and changes that characterize urban development and spatial organization.

Appel publié par Cities. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
